title: Conventional PMI - borrower-requested cancellation
facts: For covered residential mortgages under the Homeowners Protection Act, a borrower may generally request cancellation of private mortgage insurance when the principal balance is scheduled to reach 80% of the home's original value, if statutory conditions are satisfied.

Conditions can include a written request, good payment history, current payments, evidence that property value has not declined where required, and no subordinate lien that would prevent cancellation.
The federal HPA applies to qualifying private mortgage insurance, not FHA mortgage insurance.
